claims.text: An all-suite resort on the beach of Uvero Alto, on the easternmost coast of the Dominican Republic.

findings.quote: all suite sanctuary on the easternmost coast of the Dominican Republic in Uvero Alto
is located on the beautiful, unspoiled beach of Uvero Alto

claims.text: The resort sits north of the sprawling all-inclusives of Punta Cana.

findings.quote: beachfront retreat north of the sprawling all-inclusives of Punta Cana

claims.text: Hard woods, palapa (cane-thatched) roofs, cathedral ceilings and natural stone touches showcase the resort's eco-friendly architecture and nod to the Dominican Republic's history.

findings.quote: Hard woods, palapa (cane-thatched) roofs, cathedral ceilings and natural stone touches showcase the resort’s eco-friendly architecture and are a nod to the Dominican Republic’s history.

claims.text: The open-air lobby has a soaring peaked thatch roof.

findings.quote: The open-air lobby has a soaring peaked thatch roof

claims.text: Rooms are divided between two-story thatched buildings and freestanding villas, no more than a one-minute walk from the beach.

findings.quote: divided between two-story thatched buildings and freestanding villas, are arranged around two snaking pools and are no more than a one-minute walk from the beach

claims.text: Rooms have dark hardwood floors and furniture, white-on-white beds and immense bathrooms with black slate showers and deep soaking tubs.

findings.quote: wicker ceilings, dark hardwood floors and furniture, white-on-white beds, immense bathrooms with black slate showers and deep soaking tubs

claims.text: The resort is all-inclusive under Zoetry's Endless Privileges, where everything is included.

findings.quote: The **All-inclusive Zoetry Agua Punta Cana** has been a AAA Four Diamond award winner since 2012 and includes Zoëtry’s signature Endless Privileges®, where everything is included.

claims.text: There are four a la carte restaurants serving Caribbean and international flavors.

findings.quote: Caribbean and international flavors are used in the gourmet cuisine at the four a la carte restaurants

claims.text: The Zoetry Spa offers indigenous treatments.

findings.quote: indigenous treatments at the Zoëtry Spa

claims.text: Yoga classes include Flow, Gentle and Hatha, along with pranayama meditation.

findings.quote:
- Yoga (Flow, Gentle, Hatha)
- Pranayama meditation

claims.text: Water activities include kayaking, catamaran and snorkeling, with kite surfing lessons, fishing and scuba diving at additional cost.

findings.quote:
- Kayaking
- Kite surfing lessons\*
- Catamaran
- Fishing\*
- Snorkeling
- Scuba diving\*
\*Additional costs may apply

claims.text: The suites draw inspiration from nature and the indigenous Taino culture, with palapa roofs, cathedral ceilings, teak furniture and rich wood accents.

findings.quote: spacious suites that draw inspiration from nature and the indigenous Taino culture, with cane-thatched roofs (palapas), cathedral ceilings, teak furniture and rich wood accents everywhere

claims.text: The resort has two large infinity pools and serpentine water trails.

findings.quote: Two large infinity pools and serpentine water trails

claims.text: The Zoetry Spa has Finnish and steam saunas, an indoor pool with Inox bubble beds, sensation showers and Natura Bisse products.

findings.quote:
- Finnish and steam saunas
- Indoor pool and Inox bubble beds
- Sensation showers
- Luxury Natura Bissé spa products

claims.text: Local-culture experiences include wine tasting with the resort's sommelier, horseback riding on the beach, cooking classes and cigar rolling classes.

findings.quote:
- Wine tasting with resort’s sommelier
- Horseback riding on the beach
- Cocktail lessons
- Cooking classes
- Cigar rolling classes

claims.text: The resort has a 200-yard stretch of beach along the Caribbean Sea.

findings.quote: With its stunning 200 yard stretch of pristine beach along the shimmering Caribbean Sea

claims.text: The last two miles of the approach road are very rough; a helicopter transfer from Punta Cana airport takes about ten minutes.

findings.quote: the last two miles of the approach road are so bone rattling that it may be worth ponying up more than $250 for the ten-minute helicopter transfer from the airport in Punta Cana

claims.text: Activity programming changes through the year and depends on the weather; some activities, such as scuba diving and fishing, cost extra.

findings.quote: Activities programming changes throughout the year, often without notice, is subject to weather conditions
- Fishing\*
- Scuba diving\*
\*Additional costs may apply
